description: src/Enemy/gatekeeper.cpp predefined the DummyStrings guard and redefined the pair as char arrays to move them out of .sdata.
The header is the convention; a section mismatch stays nonmatching, with no comment, and is reported in the attempt summary.
src/MoveBG/MapObjHide.cpp added the upstream dummy(Vec*) idiom with no evidence of which objects it emits.
The helper is accepted only with the emitted-symbol comment; otherwise it is an uncalled static.
src/Enemy/bathtubkiller.cpp added #pragma dont_inline, marked with a TODO.
In SMS the pragma is rejected marked or not, and the TODO is an agent comment. Remove both; if the inlining cannot be explained, leave the function nonmatching.
src/Camera/lensflare.cpp TLensFlare::perform carried an agent TODO about the frame ("no clanker TODOs", doldecomp/sms #331).
Delete matching-state notes; the function stays nonmatching without one.

bad_pattern: mAnmData->createSampleModelData(getModel()->getModelData());
description: src/M3DUtil/MActor.cpp setModel swapped mModel-> for getModel()-> with no other change ("fakematch prolly", doldecomp/sms #330).
Keep an accessor only when a header, the map or a sibling decomp shows it at this call site.

bad_pattern:
unk18[i].mAttnFn
    = material->getColorBlock()->getColorChan(i)->getAttnFn();
description: src/M3DUtil/SampleCtrlNode.cpp ctor routed getColorChan(i) through getColorBlock() "to make the stack frame size fit" (doldecomp/sms #330).
Changing inlines to fit the frame is a fakematch; keep the upstream call.

bad_pattern: Vec sunPos = mPosition;
description: src/Camera/sunmgr.cpp TSunMgr::load uses getPosition(); the maintainer first flagged it, then retracted: "wrong inline, this one is correct" (doldecomp/sms #331).
An accessor backed by evidence stays. The lint asks for that evidence; it does not reject the accessor.
SMS has no TODO-marked pragma exception: the pragma and the TODO are both rejected.
Leave the function nonmatching, with no comment, when clean source does not match.
A one-expression static inline with a single call site is a stack-shaping helper, not lost source.
In SMS fold it back; a // fabricated marker does not make it acceptable.
SMS upstream has no data-ordering helper; an order_sdata2 function and its @todo are both rejected.
Recover the code that consumes the literal, or leave the .sdata2 order mismatch nonmatching with no comment.

src/Player/MarioMove.cpp added planeDistance, and MarioPhysics.cpp added canHang (return mario->getHeldObject() == nullptr && !mario->onYoshi();). No header declares them and mario.MAP has no planeDistance__ or canHang__ symbol.
They are invented helpers: dropped even though checkCurrentPlane reached 99.90% with planeDistance. Restore the upstream code at the call sites and leave the function nonmatching.
src/Enemy/bossManta.cpp added getWaterHitCount with two call sites to fix .rodata dedup. The map does not name it, so it is invented, whatever the call count.
Restore the two local tables and leave the unit nonmatching.
src/GC2D/ConsoleStr.cpp tested the same value twice to change codegen. Nobody writes x != 0 || x != 0; the same goes for isActorType(X) || isActorType(X).
Restore the single test and leave the function nonmatching.
src/MarioUtil/MtxUtil.cpp subtracted a negation instead of adding. The same applies to -(-x) and !(i != 17 && i != 18).
Write the plain arithmetic or test.
src/Enemy/bosseel.cpp stored a value that the next statement overwrites. Repeated identical assignments and x = x; are the same kind of dead store.
Keep the upstream statements.
src/MoveBG/MapObjInit.cpp added an empty if body to change codegen. Empty else bodies and a case that only breaks are the same.
Delete it and leave the function nonmatching.

bad_pattern:
s16 tmp = param_3->mRotation.x;
m_value = tmp;
description: doldecomp/sms #330: a single-use s16 temp was added only to move codegen. It re-spells the same read, so the program does not change.
The temp is a probe: it shows the original reads the value differently. Find the real construct (an inline, a type, a different member) with real_code_evidence and remove the temp.

bad_pattern:
unk18[i].mAttnFn
    = material->getColorBlock()->getColorChan(i)->getAttnFn();
description: src/M3DUtil/SampleCtrlNode.cpp routed getColorChan(i) through getColorBlock() to fit the frame (doldecomp/sms #330). Both inlines read the same channel: same behaviour, different codegen.
Keep the upstream call unless evidence shows the original used the hop; the codegen change is a probe, not the fix.

A real fix, kept: TNerveNameKuriLand::execute (src/Enemy/namekuri.cpp, PR 13 of #189). Upstream called setBckAnm(4) again while bck 4 was still playing and the actor was grounded; the fix only calls it when bck 4 is not the current animation. The program behaves differently and the function matches with no steering.
Real fixes change a condition, callee, constant, type, control flow or initializer. Keep them, in their own statement, and drop any steering around them.

src/Map/MapEventMare.cpp: mario.MAP lists `UNUSED 0000c0 ........ emitEffect__21TMareEventDepressWallFi Map.a MapEventMare.cpp`, and upstream (7fed828b) keeps it as `{ }`. An agent branch gave it this body.

Emptying the body changes no function in the target object, so it is dead per the stub test. We dropped it from #344 before review (4992225c, "drop reconstructed dead emitEffect"). Keep the upstream stub.

src/Enemy/chuuhana.cpp (doldecomp/sms #342, commit 360931f3, line 719): mario.MAP lists `UNUSED 000120 ........ rolling__9TChuuHanaFv Enemy.a chuuhana.cpp`. Mrkol: "Made up bullshit, remove. UNUSED functions may only be reconstructed when they were inlined into other functions in the same TU, this one seems to be truly dead code". The body (and margeVelocity's, line 554) was removed before merge; 3ebd9d9c keeps `{ }`.

The stub test does show inline evidence: TNerveChuuHanaRoll::execute falls from 86% to 45% when the body is emptied. The PR did not show it, so the body went. Keep the stub unless the change carries that evidence (caller and before/after match); this is not an accepted reconstruction.

bad_pattern:
if (strcmp(name, "Koopa") == 0)
		return new TKoopa("クッパ");
description: src/System/MarNameRefGen_BossEnemy.cpp (doldecomp/sms #347): TKoopa's vtable and constructor live in Enemy.a Koopa.cpp, and src/Enemy/Koopa.cpp defines neither: TKoopa is not ready to construct.

The maintainer closed the PR: "Please leave MarNameRefGen alone, people will fill it in eventually when the relevant stuff is properly decompiled." Keep the upstream TODO until Koopa.cpp defines the constructor; `return new TTinKoopa;` is fine because tinkoopa defines its constructor.

preferred_shape: // No TKillerManager declaration: leave it until Enemy/killer is decompiled.
description: include/Enemy/Killer.hpp (doldecomp/sms #347) gained a TKillerManager declaration so MarNameRefGen could build `new TKillerManager`. __vt__14TKillerManager is in Enemy.a killer.cpp, and src/Enemy/killer.cpp defines none of its members: its implementation has not started.
"don't jump the fence please": the declaration belongs to whoever decompiles killer.cpp. Upstream declarations already in the header stay; forward declarations are fine.
